optimizedDescription.value: Defines capability-aware, metadata-contract templates and runtime frontmatter rendering for all supported skill and agent installs.

optimizedContext.value:
# Skill templates source

## Rules

- Sources: `packages/skills/templates/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md.tpl`; agents: `packages/skills/templates/agents/<agent-name>/SPECD-AGENT.md.tpl`. Sources `.md.tpl`; installed outputs `.md`.
- Every skill/agent dir: `skill.meta.json`/`specd-agent.meta.json`. Schema: `kind`, `supportedCapabilities`, `requiredCapabilities`, `requiredSharedTemplates`; `kind` matches `skills/` or `agents/`.
- Layout: `templates/skills/`, `templates/agents/`, `templates/shared/`. No `specd-metadata/` skill template. `shared.meta.json` not canonical consumer source.
- Rendering: deterministic, single-pass Handlebars; no arbitrary code/runtime scripting. Capabilities: `mcp` MCP branches; `agents` delegation branches; `frontmatter` injects `variables.frontmatter`.
- Shared reference exactly `@{{sharedFolder}}/shared.md`; `sharedFolder` project-root-relative.
- Graph impact: dependents=`--direction dependents` (`upstream` compatibility); dependencies=`--direction dependencies` (`downstream` compatibility); both=`--direction both`. Files: `specd graph impact --file <path1> <path2> ...`; never `--changes`; never call downstream dependents.
- Graph search snippets opt-in: include `--snippet` only for previews; omit for identifiers/locations. `json`/`toon` omit `snippet` absent `--snippet`.
- Frontmatter: canonical metadata + vendor contracts. Plugins pass structured `variables.frontmatter`, capabilities; never prebuilt YAML. `@specd/skills` injects only skill-local frontmatter-capable render; shared files never frontmatter. Emit target-recognized fields only.
- Runtime field coverage: Codex `name`, `description`; Copilot `name`, `description`, `license`, `allowed-tools`, `user-invocable`, `disable-model-invocation`; Open Code `name`, `description`, `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`.
- Workflow templates: code/spec links mention `specd changes implementation add`; archive resolves/reviews tracked implementation. No status scans (`stale`, `missing`, `invalid`) or routine `specd spec generate-metadata`; present it only forced rebuild/cache-warm/repair/diagnostic.
- Optimizer agents gate on `specd project status --format toon`: only act when top-level `llmOptimizedContext` == `true`; never `specd specs metadata` gate. Persist direct `cli:spec-optimizations` set options; never combine with `--input`; never generate metadata afterward.
- Read surfaces: `specd specs show <spec-id>` raw authoring/review; `specd specs context <spec-id>` semantic/filter/dependency/optimized context; `specd specs metadata <spec-id>` self-healed projection diagnostics only. Archive may inspect `source`, `regenerated`, warnings; config still top-level `llmOptimizedContext`. Tests assert exact commands/fields.
- `templates/skills/specd-fasttrack/`: `SKILL.md.tpl`, `skill.meta.json` (`kind: "skill"`, `requiredSharedTemplates` includes `shared.md`, all referenced capabilities), no static frontmatter, shared reference exact above. Rendered workflow immediately updates `.specd-exploration.md` after meaningful decision, scope/contract finding, edit, implementation link, test/debug, audit; preserve changed/why/affected files/symbols. Final consolidation summarizes, never replaces increments.

## Constraints

- No static frontmatter YAML. `.md.tpl` sources; every skill dir `skill.meta.json`.
- `shared.meta.json` not canonical shared requirement source; installed markdown no absolute paths.
- Templates may use install-time frontmatter insertion. Plugins declare capabilities/structured `variables.frontmatter`; never unsupported runtime fields. `@specd/skills` injects final skill-local frontmatter.
- Graph terms use dependents/dependencies; `upstream`/`downstream` compatibility only; use `--file`, never `--changes`.
